HeavyWarpFlamer.description: Deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style={[DamageProfileTypeStyle]}>{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} {[DamageProfileType]}</style> to an enemy within range {[range]}. Adds <style="Stat_Hits">+1 hit</style> for each attack with <style="DMG_Psychic">Psychic Damage</style> that friendly units have performed this turn. Cannot exceed <style="Stat_Hits">{[maxNrOfHits]} hits</style>. If this attack defeats the target, any leftover hits are scored against enemies adjacent to the target and within range {[range]}, prioritising kills.
